title: Rogers' craft as human-built but aerodynamically pointless
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Rogers' craft as human-built but aerodynamically pointless, about c. 2000 at Secret hangar building, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> I I think that what I saw was uh human um built.

plain: A doctor who worked with NASA, Greg Rogers, told podcast host Jesse Michels that around 2000 he saw a strange craft inside a secret hangar. He says he thinks it was built by humans, even though its shape made no sense for flying through air. If so, it would point to a hidden human technology that does not depend on normal flight.
